VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 23 tests pass and the package.json diff (ATT) confirms no dependency changes—but neither attests that the *rounding drift bug itself* was fixed. The passing tests only satisfy criterion (1) if a test actually exercises the netting rounding drift. There is no evidence (no failing-then-passing test, no diff of the fix, no test targeting the rounding behavior) demonstrating the specific defect was addressed rather than merely that a pre-existing suite still passes. The claim of a fix rests on the SELF report, which is insufficient.
